subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I know that I can count on my best friend to be by my side through _______ and thin.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"thick"** means having a large distance between two opposite sides; in this context, it refers to the phrase "through thick and thin," which means through good times and bad times. (मोटा/घना)

 
 
• **Example: **They have remained friends through thick and thin, supporting each other no matter what.
 
 
 
• **"thick and thin"** is an idiom that signifies unwavering support through all circumstances, both favorable and unfavorable. (अच्छे और बुरे समय में)
 
 
• **Example: **She promised to stand by him through **thick and thin.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is** 'I know that I can count on my best friend to be by my side through thick and thin.'__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tough** (कठिन): Refers to something strong or difficult to deal with.

 
 
• **Example:** He is known for making ***tough*** decisions during crises.
 
 
 
• **Heavy** (भारी): Refers to something of great weight or difficult to lift.
 
 
• **Example:** The box was too ***heavy*** for me to carry alone.
 
 
 
• **Fat** (मोटा): Refers to having a large amount of excess flesh.
 
 
• **Example:** The cat was so ***fat*** that it could barely move.
